answers.explanation: L4 pins long-lived multiplexed connections; L7 balances requests within them.
Uneven costs need an algorithm that sees real load.
Random pairs break the herd without shared state.
Consistent hashing keeps most users in place when the pool changes.
In-flight requests finish, and no new ones arrive.
A single balancer is a single point of failure too.
Active checks probe; passive checks observe.
